title: Use the title architect only when registered
what: Use the word architect to describe oneself in a business or practice only if registered as an architect.

sources.title: Architects Act 1929 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person who is not an architect shall not, in respect of any practice, trade, or business carried on by him or her, any office or employment held or exercised by him or her, or any work done by him or her, take or use to describe himself or herself– (a) the word "architect"

sources.title: Architects Act 1929 (Tas)
